title: iberis intermedia var. dunalii
intro: Iberis intermedia var. dunalii, commonly known as Candytuft, is a flowering plant species in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its health benefits such as wound healing and skin protection. The therapeutic actions of Iberis intermedia var. dunalii include its ability to exhibit antiviral, antibacterial, and antifungal activities, as well as its capacity to modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic properties include isothiocyanates, alkaloids, and other compounds that have been identified in its leaves, stems, and flowers.
